published.source: Hunter ruling 2026-10-25 (standards 23: Mark duty assumed, every hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark and the raid's is off; was 1167.6)

summary: Marksmanship with a cat instead of Lone Wolf. The pet deals about 16% of the damage.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, walk to 12 yd, Hunter's Mark at -1.5s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +143 ranged attack power) 1.5s before the pull and again in its last 3s; the raid's mark is off
Arcane Shot on cooldown (above Aimed Shot, no mana floor)
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot (mana >= 40%)
Serpent Sting when it is down (after Aimed Shot)
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana >= 10 x seconds left
Melee weave: between Auto Shots, walk in for a main hand swing with Raptor Strike queued when the next Auto Shot waits 1.2s or less and the shot cooldowns stay down, while mana >= 25 x seconds left
Cat (1.0s) bites and claws on its own; Auto Shot throughout
caveats: Assumed: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power (the client has 50). Hunter's Mark gives 143, the server hotfix (the client has 71).
Aspect of the Hawk stays at rank 5 (90 RAP). Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
The pet takes 10% of the hunter's ranged attack power, its crit and its hit, on its own 254 attack power (beta pet sheets).
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (beta log fit: 11% and 3.5%).
Auto Shot fires through casts and winds up 0.5s, which moving cancels.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece aren't active. They would add 13.
Holds Sniper Shot and the weave back for mana; 1137.3 DPS at 300s.
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic.
Pet hits scale with attack speed, as a level 17 pet sheet shows. A 1.0s raptor would add about 2 (Savage Rend), but none that fast is known.
A 2.5s bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era's 14% pouch.
Mark duty is assumed: the hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark, and the raid's mark is off. That costs about 0.5 to 2.5 DPS at 180s (1.4 here).

Scorpid Sting isn't a duty: it shares Insect Swarm's 2% hit-reduction slot, which Balance druids keep up for its own damage, so a hunter on it would pay about 85 to 100 DPS (Serpent Sting's slot) for nothing.
notes: Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_mm, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Every hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark (standards 23, Mark duty assumed), so the raid's debuffs.huntersMark is off.
